modifiers: downward arrow onto horizontal bar in bottom-right corner
depiction.composition: centered play button framed by three rounded L-shaped corners, with a download glyph replacing the fourth corner

readings.meaning: export screen recording or video clip

ambiguity: The corner brackets resemble a full-screen or screen-capture frame, so it can be read as exporting a screen recording rather than downloading any video.

reasoning: The icon combines a play triangle inside viewfinder/screen-frame brackets with a download arrow in the lower right. It clearly signifies downloading, saving, or exporting a video or screen recording, which is a common concrete task for travel prep, coursework, and video editing, though at very small sizes it could be confused with a plain play/fullscreen button.
